info.title: Midnight Persona Web API
info.description: Supabase-authenticated Gateway and Web Commerce. Responses contain public account/chat data only. Browser sessions use standard Supabase Google OAuth/Anonymous Auth and refresh. Authenticated routes send Cache-Control: no-store. Protected n8n server delivery never includes bearer tokens. NOWPayments server callbacks use IPN signatures. Video commerce extends the same purchases and account subscriptions. Video URLs are short-lived and issued only through an owned delivery operation.

Previous/next are free and expose only unlocked photos. photo_regen returns a locked offer without its URL; use existing media unlock/purchase flow for free rights, credits or payment. Event.description: Durable event snapshots refresh canonical history. A completed delivery event carries a stable video message ID; repeated access never creates another event.

History.description: Chronological shared text/photo/video history projected from existing message and successful delivery journals. Stable IDs deduplicate event refreshes; opaque versioned cursors preserve database timestamp precision. Pending delivery recovery is exposed by the existing media endpoint. event_cursor and quick_replies are read in the same repeatable-read snapshot. After a cursor gap, rebase to this high-water mark and reconcile saved operations.

entry_mode.description: Server-owned paid reset context only; never accepted from browser requests.

payment_token.description: Existing confirmed fulfillment token; n8n verifies account/chat and consumes once.

QuickRepliesData.description: Actual SQL producers: exactly three configured opening options, or an empty options list; configured follow-up strings after the selected opening response. Values come from character_opening_replies. No generated guesses.

MediaOfferData.description: Commerce producer; query catalog with chat_code for the effective server price. Optional price is decimal text, never client-authoritative. media_kind reserves future extension to video.

review_required.description: A second separately paid checkout for a consumed panel requires operator payment reconciliation; no duplicate delivery.

video_deliveries.description: Unfinished Web deliveries in this chat, including previous scenes. Recover their existing IDs through the access endpoint; never create replacement purchases.

FeatureAccess.description: Existing/free feature right; no external checkout. A fast skip remains unfulfilled until the engine commits its scene reset.

VideoDelivery.description: An owned delivery journal entry. Paired deliveries stay in their existing photo panel; legacy unpaired deliveries remain playable in chat history. Each access issues a fresh signed Storage URL valid for 120 seconds, including after subscription or scene changes. An uncertain initial delivery is not automatically repeated.
